title: Memorial Park Middle School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. · March 12–14, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing Memorial Park Middle School’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Departure for Washington, D.C.

  • Depart for Washington, D.C. — overnight travel

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & Capitol Hill

  • Breakfast allocation
  • Welcome to Washington, D.C.! Meet your Landmark Leader
  • Landmark Leader–led walking tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Lunch at Capitol
  • Public guided tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Visit the National Archives Museum
  • Depart for dinner
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: The White House, Ford’s Theatre & the Holocaust Museum

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • White House photo opportunity from Lafayette Park / Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Visit Ford’s Theatre, the Petersen House, and the Aftermath Exhibits
  • Lunch included
  • Visit the Martin Luther King, Jr. Memorial
  • Souvenir stop
  • Visit the United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
  • Dinner allocation
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 4: Mount Vernon & Gettysburg

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate
  • Lunch at Mount Vernon
  • Visit the World War II Memorial
  • Admission to the Film, Cyclorama & Museum Experience in Gettysburg
  • Guided tour of the Gettysburg Battlefield with a Licensed Battlefield Guide
  • Dinner allocation
  • Depart for home
introHeading: Memorial Park Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From the rows of Arlington National Cemetery to the battlefield at Gettysburg, this trip brings American history and civics to life at every turn. Students will take a guided tour of the United States Capitol, stand before the Lincoln, MLK and World War II Memorials, explore the Library of Congress, the National Archives and the Holocaust Memorial Museum, walk the grounds of George Washington’s Mount Vernon, and tour the Gettysburg Battlefield with a licensed guide. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
